title: psephellus carbonatus
intro: Psephellus carbonatus, commonly known as Mountain Everlasting, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the daisy family. The Mountain Everlasting plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is used to treat various health conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Psephellus carbonatus include its anti-inflammatory and antiviral properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of relieving pain and reducing fever. The bioactive constituents of the Mountain Everlasting plant include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
